description: Search aircraft for sale in the United States (private jets, helicopters, turboprops, piston aircraft), the same listings as altivojets.com/en-us/aircraft-for-sale/: filter by type, make, model, US state, year range and maximum asking price in US dollars. Returns up to `limit` aircraft (default 10, max 20), newest first, with year, model, serial number, total time, location, asking price (or price on request) and the listing page. Listings are co-brokered with the seller's broker and the seller is never named. US only.

price_max.description: Optional maximum asking price in US dollars (aircraft priced on request are left out).

type.description: Optional: private-jets, helicopters, turboprops, piston-aircraft or vip-airliners.

name: search_aircraft_for_sale
title: Search aircraft for sale
